kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أجتنب (form VIII)
# أَجْتَنِبُ (ʔajtanibu) /ʔad͡ʒ.ta.ni.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِجْتَنَبَ (ijtanaba)
# أُجْتَنَبُ (ʔujtanabu) /ʔud͡ʒ.ta.na.bu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَنَبَ (ijtanaba)
# أَجْتَنِبَ (ʔajtaniba) /ʔad͡ʒ.ta.ni.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِجْتَنَبَ (ijtanaba)
# أُجْتَنَبَ (ʔujtanaba) /ʔud
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
